rangeKm.note: carsales (Redbook) 2026 eDrive40 M Sport: 550 km ADR, 582 km WLTP (old best case), 550 km manufacturer; 20-inch staggered wheels as standard. CarExpert spec page also 550 km. Below EV Database MY25 WLTP TEL 618 km, so passes direction test.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: linear interpolation of EV Database MY25 WLTP rated consumption (TEL 238 Wh/mi = 14.8 kWh/100km at 618 km; TEH 286 Wh/mi = 17.8 at 517 km; https://ev-database.org/uk/car/3112/BMW-i5-eDrive40-Saloon) to the 550 km AU range: 14.8 + (618-550)/(618-517) x 3.0 = 16.8. Held 16.6 had no traceable source; CarExpert spec page quotes 181 Wh/km (likely high-end of band).
